---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this solve, or what's currently missing/awkward? (Not
"I want X" — explain the underlying need first.)

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you've thought about, and why you didn't prefer them.

## Scope

Is this a small, self-contained change, or does it need a design spec
first? This project designs non-trivial features in `spec/future/` before
implementation — see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#project-workflow-spec-first).

## Additional context

Anything else relevant (mockups, related issues, prior discussion).
